questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content:
5 moles of an ideal gas at 100 K are allowed
to undergo reversible compression till its
temperature becomes 200 K.
If C<sub>V</sub> = 28 JK<sup>–1</sup>mol<sup>–1</sup>, calculate <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.885ex" height="1.62ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -716 833 716" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="394" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-394"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>U and <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.885ex" height="1.62ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -716 833 716" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="394" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-394"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>pV for
this process. (R = 8.0 JK<sup>–1</sup> mol<sup>–1</sup>]

options.content: <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.885ex" height="1.62ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -716 833 716" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="394" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-394"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>U = 14 kJ; <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.885ex" height="1.62ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -716 833 716" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="394" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-394"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>(pV) = 4 kJ

<mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.885ex" height="1.62ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -716 833 716" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="394" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-394"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>U = 2.8 kJ; <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.885ex" height="1.62ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -716 833 716" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="394" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-394"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>(pV) = 0.8 kJ

questions.explanation:
For ideal gas,

U = nCvT

= 5 28 (200 - 100)

= 14 kJ

We know,

PV = nRT

(PV) = nRT = 5 8 100 = 4 kJ
